item.title: The wall you can see from the Moon
item.summary: Why the Great Wall of China is the one human structure visible from the Moon.

sections.heading: A wall to see from space
paragraphs: The Great Wall of China is so long that astronauts standing on the Moon can see it with their own eyes.
It is the only human-made structure visible from that far away.

sections.heading: Why it stands out
paragraphs: Its winding line is easy to pick out against the land.

body.takeaway: The Great Wall is visible from the Moon.
